payload.title: Prove priming with a held-out agreement number before and after N labels
payload.description:
Feature: Priming proof
  Scenario: Freeze a held-out set from editor reviews
    Given reviewed References of the publication's canonical corpus
    When the operator freezes a held-out set
    Then a fixed, fingerprinted set of items and human labels is written and never regenerated under the same proof id
  Scenario: Measure agreement before and after N priming labels
    Given a frozen held-out set and accepted priming examples
    When the proof runs at N = 0 and each scheduled N
    Then each point opens a fresh cyclotron with only the first N examples and reports agreement, precision and recall on the held-out set
  Scenario: Visitors see the number
    Given an approved proof report
    When a visitor opens the publication's Cyclotron proof page
    Then they see agreement before and after N labels, the held-out size and the method, with no item text or explanations
